titleEs: Maxroll D4 vs Mobalytics D4 — el duelo de los hubs editoriales
titleEn: Maxroll D4 vs Mobalytics D4 — the editorial hubs showdown
descriptionEs: Los dos hubs editoriales dominantes de Diablo IV. Maxroll prioriza depth con prose larga y planner interactivo; Mobalytics prioriza speed con tier lists visuales y cards compactas.
descriptionEn: The two dominant Diablo IV editorial hubs. Maxroll prioritizes depth with long prose and an interactive planner; Mobalytics prioritizes speed with visual tier lists and compact cards.
verdictEs: Maxroll si quieres entender el por qué de cada decision y leer build guides largas con justification. Mobalytics si solo quieres quick scan del meta state y comparar builds visualmente. Muchos players usan ambos — Mobalytics para scan, Maxroll para deep dive del build elegido.
verdictEn: Maxroll if you want to understand the why behind each decision and read long build guides with justification. Mobalytics if you just want a quick scan of meta state and visual build comparison. Many players use both — Mobalytics to scan, Maxroll to deep-dive the chosen build.

useCases.labelEs: Deep dive de build con justification per slot
useCases.labelEn: Deep build dive with per-slot justification
useCases.reasonEs: Maxroll guides son prose long-form con explicación de cada skill, paragon node y aspect choice. Mobalytics cards son más compactas, sacrifican depth por scanability.
useCases.reasonEn: Maxroll guides are long-form prose explaining each skill, paragon node, and aspect choice. Mobalytics cards are more compact, sacrificing depth for scanability.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics presenta tier lists con visual badges (S/A/B) y build cards compactas. Maxroll requiere abrir guides extensas para el mismo info — más slow.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics presents tier lists with visual badges (S/A/B) and compact build cards. Maxroll requires opening extensive guides for the same info — slower.

useCases.labelEs: Patch reaction rapid post balance change
useCases.reasonEs: Maxroll updatea tier lists y guides dentro de 24-48h post-patch con análisis editorial. Mobalytics suele tardar 1-2 días más.
useCases.reasonEn: Maxroll updates tier lists and guides within 24-48h post-patch with editorial analysis. Mobalytics tends to take 1-2 days longer.

useCases.reasonEs: UI visual de Mobalytics se traduce mejor a mobile. Maxroll's prose larga es harder de digerir en pantalla chica.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics' visual UI translates better to mobile. Maxroll's long prose is harder to digest on a small screen.

useCases.reasonEs: Maxroll embed planner interactive en cada guide para clonar y modificar builds. Mobalytics no tiene planner equivalente — es presentation tool, no planning tool.
useCases.reasonEn: Maxroll embeds an interactive planner in each guide to clone and modify builds. Mobalytics has no equivalent planner — it's a presentation tool, not a planning tool.
